Poll Maker Lite

Create a quick poll with custom options, vote on it, and watch live percentage bars — votes are saved on this device.

0
Total votes

Click an option to cast a vote. Votes are stored on this device.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your poll question and add options (at least two).
  2. Press Create poll.
  3. Click an option to vote and watch the live results.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I make a poll?

Type a question, add at least two options, and press Create poll. Then click an option to cast votes.

Are votes saved?

Yes — votes are stored in your browser's localStorage, so they survive page reloads on this device.

Can I reset or delete a poll?

Press Reset votes to zero all counts, or New poll to start over.

Is this private?

Yes — everything, including vote storage, stays in your browser.
